summary: Shows manually creating HTTP (5985) and HTTPS (5986) WinRM listeners with New-Item on WSMan:\localhost\Listener; HTTPS needs a certificate thumbprint from LocalMachine\My. Explains Address values *, IP:..., and MAC:....
questions: How do I create a WinRM listener manually without Enable-PSRemoting?
How do I bind a WinRM listener to one IP address only?
Where must the WinRM HTTPS certificate be installed?

answer_card.title: Manually creating WinRM listeners
answer_card.answer_md:
```powershell
New-Item -Path 'WSMan:\localhost\Listener' -Address '*' -Enabled $true -Port 5985 -Transport HTTP -Force

# HTTPS
New-Item -Path 'WSMan:\localhost\Listener' -Address '*' -CertificateThumbprint '<thumbprint>' -Enabled $true -Port 5986 -Transport HTTPS -Force
```

The certificate must be in the `LocalMachine\My` store. `Address` can be `*` (all), `IP:<addr>` (one IPv4/IPv6 address), or `MAC:32-a3-58-90-be-cc` (one adapter).
